title: Remove Duplicates, Keep Order
hints: A set is great for "have I seen this?" — but it has no order.
Walk the array; keep an element only the first time you insert it into the set.
jsBridge: JS: `[...new Set(arr)]` keeps insertion order because JS `Set` is ordered. Swift's `Set` is **unordered**, so `Array(Set(arr))` scrambles the order. Filter with a `seen` set, or use `OrderedSet` from swift-collections.

compass.q: JS `Set` preserves insertion order. Swift's doesn't. Which JS habits break because of that?
`filter { seen.insert($0).inserted }` vs `OrderedSet(arr)`: which would you ship, and what does adding a package cost?
The `insert` in `filter` mutates captured state. Is a side-effecting closure inside `filter` OK style?
